--- GAL DISPATCH ---
ACTION: Run: gal pipeline '<REPO>/.dev/plans/x.prompt.md' --phase implement --task T-NNN --workdir '<REPO>'. The single gal binary reads routing, assembles and dispatches the executor in-process with no sibling dispatch executable, and emits a Dispatch: marker line. For test/audit it auto-resolves a deterministic receipt (.dev/pipeline/receipts/T-NNN-implement.receipt.md), embeds it in the spec, and verifies the executor wrote it; pass --receipt only to override. Exit 0 -> completed (write-back verified). Exit 1 -> no-receipt or disconnected-partial. Exit 2 -> unavailable/degraded. Fall back to role-playing the CODER golem only on exit 2.
BYPASS_PERMISSION_WARNING: SECURITY: headless executor runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions or --allow-all. Full trust of secondary CLI filesystem access. Enable only in a trusted local environment.
COMMAND: offload
DISPATCH_MODE: offload
EXECUTOR: claude
MODEL: claude-haiku-4-5
OFFLOAD: headless-executor
ON_COMPLETE: Record in the execution prompt the Dispatch: marker line emitted by gal pipeline (phase=implement task=T-NNN role=CODER executor=claude model=claude-haiku-4-5 state=<state> session_id=<id> log=<path>).
PIPELINE_PHASE: implement
ROLE: CODER
TASK_SCOPE: T-NNN
TASK_SPEC: <REPO>/.dev/plans/x.prompt.md
